smoke.reason: Test-development precision 0.40 < 0.50; negative-image alarms 4/15=0.2667 > 0.10; val alarms also 4/15. Appearance alarm gate failed (val fog 2 vs baseline 1, cloud 3 vs 1; test glare 2 vs 1). Higher recall/F1 does not satisfy predeclared precision/false-alarm criteria.
smoke.visual_review: 12 positive and 12 negative images; misses faint plumes, alarms on fog/cloud/horizon/glare. Both unlabelled operator photos have false smoke boxes on water litter and stony shoreline; not tuning evidence.
smoke.rollback: No promotion performed; original registry and FireSmoke weights remain active. No rollback action required.
smoke.scope: Source-val repartition; baseline prior source exposure unknown. Not independent geographic/event validation. No fire training.
